;International relations
*[[United States free-trade agreements]], [[Mexico–United States relations#Trump administration|Mexico–United States relations]]
**The [[United States]] and [[Mexico]] reach common ground on key trade terms in the [[North American Free Trade Agreement]]. [[Canada]] has yet to sign off on the agreement. [https://www.bbc.com/news/business-45323634 (BBC)] [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-trade-nafta/u-s-mexico-reach-nafta-deal-pressure-turns-to-canada-idUSKCN1LC1E7 (Reuters)]

;Law and crime
*A [[United Nations Human Rights Council]] report based on 875 interviews recommends [[Min Aung Hlaing]] and five other generals in [[Myanmar]] be investigated and prosecuted for genocide, crimes against humanity and war crimes since the 1960s. [https://www.upi.com/amp/Top_News/World-News/2018/08/27/UN-report-calls-for-Myanmar-military-leaders-to-face-genocide-charges/7301535364181/ (UPI)]
*[[Sri Lankan Civil War#Aftermath|Aftermath of the Sri Lankan Civil War]]
**[[Forensic anthropology|Forensic anthropologists]] from the [[University of Kelaniya]], [[Sri Lanka]], report that more than 90 sets of human remains have been discovered near the town of [[Mannar, Sri Lanka|Mannar]]. The mass grave is situated in an area that saw heavy fighting during the country's [[Sri Lankan Civil War|civil war]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-45296871 (BBC)]
*[[2018 Chemnitz protests]]
**Violent protests break out across Germany after a stabbing attack the day before. Several instances of racial violence are reported, and riot police have been attacked. [https://www.dw.com/en/violence-in-chemnitz-as-leftist-and-far-right-protesters-clash/a-45250620 (Deutsche Welle)]
